# Knowledge document fixtures

These fixtures cover the six knowledge writers owned by Plan 0017:
Idea Brief, PRD, Product Knowledge, Domain, Workflow, and Role. They also
exercise explicit bundle declarations, legacy compatibility, verified
normalization, generation failures, unknown-field preservation, and passive
source boundaries.

The `bundles/declared/` tree is the only OKF bundle in this fixture set.
`bundles/undeclared/` and `source-boundary/` remain outside OKF even though
they contain Markdown. The fixture evidence does not install a parser or
command runtime; the approved host capability performs deterministic
validation.
